text: bwin is one of Entain plc's brands: the group's 2024 annual report describes Entain operating a market through its bwin and Party brands, and the same report lists wholly-owned bwin subsidiaries (bwin Holdings (Malta) Limited, bwin (Deutschland) Limited, bwin Poland S.A.) among its group companies.

source.name: Entain plc, Annual Report 2024 (Canada market review and list of group companies)
source.quote: Entain operates in Ontario through its bwin and Party brands, as well as Sports Interaction, a Canadian brand acquired by the Group in February 2022.
